qs.en: You are flying off to Tokyo this evening, aren't you?

qs.s: Tu te ___ sans même dire au revoir à personne.
qs.en: You flew off without even saying goodbye to anyone.

qs.en: My friend flew off to New York last week.

qs.en: The children flew off as soon as class ended to play outside.

qs.en: When I was a child, I often flew away in my imagination to distant lands.

qs.en: The old eagle used to fly off every morning to hunt in the mountains.

qs.en: You always used to fly off before the end of meetings, which annoyed everyone.

qs.en: The swallows used to fly off to the south at the end of August.

qs.s: Les heures se ___ sans qu'ils s'en rendent compte.
qs.en: The hours used to fly by without them realizing it.

qs.en: Tomorrow at dawn, I will fly off to Montreal for the conference.

qs.en: If I am given the chance, I will fly off toward new horizons.

qs.en: You will fly off to London as soon as your visa is ready.

qs.en: The falcon will fly off as soon as the cage door is opened.

qs.en: The storks will fly off to Africa before the first frosts.

qs.en: If the children were free, they would fly out of the classroom at once.

qs.en: I want the bird to fly away freely in nature.

qs.s: La colombe s'est ___ dès que la cage a été ouverte.
qs.en: The dove flew away as soon as the cage was opened.

qs.en: My childhood flew by like a dream.

qs.en: The hours flew by during that lovely evening among friends.

qs.en: The Protestant community welcomed a new pastor who came from Alsace.

qs.en: In this region, the clergyman is a respected figure among all the village inhabitants.

qs.en: My uncle is a pastor in a small town in the south of France.

qs.s: ___ pasteur a béni les fidèles à la fin de l'office.
qs.en: The pastor blessed the faithful at the end of the service.
